card.name: Tartaruga Gora
card.summary: Enquanto esta carta estiver com a face para cima no campo, monstros com 1900 ou mais de ATK não podem declarar ataques.

textEvidence.text: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, monsters with an ATK equal to 1900 or more cannot declare an attack. The persistent, face-up source is required; the effect is disabled by monster-effect negation. Attack declarations are validated against current field state. Previous declared attacks are not retroactively cancelled. The threshold applies to both players using current ATK, including modifications; 1899 ATK can attack and 1900 ATK cannot.

card.name: Dragão Espada do Jacaré
card.summary: Fusão de Baby Dragon e Alligator's Sword. Pode atacar diretamente se todos os monstros com a face para cima do oponente forem TERRA, ÁGUA ou FOGO.

textEvidence.text: "Baby Dragon" + "Alligator's Sword". This card can attack your opponent directly if the only face-up monsters they control are EARTH, WATER, or FIRE. The persistent, face-up source is required; the effect is disabled by monster-effect negation. Attack declarations are validated against current field state. Previous declared attacks are not retroactively cancelled. The exact Fusion Materials are Baby Dragon and Alligator's Sword. Opposing face-down monsters and Spell/Trap Cards do not disqualify a direct attack; only face-up monsters with other Attributes do.
